Blur In

Image starts visibly blurred and sharpens on hover/focus.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

<div class="hover-effect blur-in">
  <img src="image.jpg" alt="description">
</div>

CSS

.hover-effect.blur-in img{
  filter: blur(8px);
  transition: filter 0.5s ease;
}
.hover-effect.blur-in:hover img,
.hover-effect.blur-in:focus-visible img{
  filter: blur(0);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hover-effect.blur-in img{
    transition: none;
  }
  .hover-effect.blur-in:hover img,
  .hover-effect.blur-in:focus-visible img{
  filter: blur(0);
  }
}

filter: blur(8px) on transitions to blur(0) on hover. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
